scope: Owner ARB approval records for the twelve required GDCs and the Authority ARB gate, examined as review evidence; no fresh provider observation and no standing publication authority.

methods.examine: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 assessment method: review, inspect or analyse assessment objects (here: pinned Authority records and the gate source).
methods.test: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 assessment method: exercise objects under specified conditions and compare actual with expected behaviour (here: repository tests named in the registry).

claim_limits: Every record has author_is_approver true under the GDC-003 bootstrap exception: one person reviewed and approved. SLSA Source v1.2 Level 4 (two different trusted persons) is not claimed; the exception and this residual risk belong in the Governance 1.0 release notes (REC-13-003).
The GDC-000 record was created after its merge (Authority PR #124, recorded deviation); the other eleven were merged before their attestation.
A record proves that the owner reviewed the exact head against GDC-002 with the stated score; it does not prove that consumer architecture meets each statement.
Repository-control obligations that need a fresh provider observation or a negative test remain pending.
